assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Generate ONE square production asset: a perfectly regular 4 by 4 photographic contact sheet atlas, exactly 16 equal square tiles, no gutters, no borders, no text, no labels, no letters, no logos, no watermark. Target 2048x2048 or higher square. Every tile is a separate realistic overhead flat lay on the SAME light warm ivory-beige matte backdrop, softly lit from upper left, natural fabric texture, elegant restrained fashion catalogue photography. Garments entirely within each cell, centered with consistent 7% breathing space, NEVER crossing cell boundaries. All outfits and accessories are exclusively adult MENSWEAR, clearly men's tailoring and proportions. No women, no people, no mannequins, no dresses, no skirts, no heels, no feminine handbags or jewelry. Each of first 8 tiles must be a coherent complete male outfit, not single isolated garment. ROW 1 left-to-right: (1) minimalist: crisp white men's Oxford shirt, charcoal straight trousers, white low-top sneakers; (2) casual: blue men's denim jacket over white T-shirt, straight indigo jeans, canvas shoes; (3) business commute: men's navy tailored blazer, light-blue shirt, beige tailored trousers and brown loafers, slim leather work bag; (4) gentle soft style: oatmeal men's knit cardigan over cream T-shirt, warm taupe trousers and suede loafers. ROW 2 left-to-right: (5) vintage: men's brown herringbone blazer, ivory turtleneck, tobacco corduroy trousers and leather lace-up shoes; (6) sporty: men's grey zip sport jacket, black tapered track pants, running sneakers; (7) streetwear: oversized men's charcoal hoodie, olive cargo pants, cap and chunky sneakers; (8) elegant: beautifully tailored men's charcoal suit jacket, matching trousers, white shirt and polished black loafers. ROW 3 priorities left-to-right: (9) comfortable: soft men's ivory sweater, relaxed taupe trousers; (10) walking-friendly: masculine neutral running shoes paired with men's practical straight chinos; (11) easy care: folded men's light-blue wrinkle-resistant button shirt and dark neat trousers; (12) natural fit: well-proportioned men's light beige overshirt and navy straight trousers, unmistakably male outfit with uncluttered fit. ROW 4 left-to-right: (13) appropriate for occasion: refined men's navy blazer over ivory collared shirt, grey trousers, brown leather shoes; (14) close-up neatly stacked natural linen/cotton fabric swatches; (15) men's transitional layers: navy lightweight coat with cream sweater and brown pants; (16) men's leather belt, simple wristwatch and neutral leather wallet. Exact row-major order and equally sized 4x4 grid are critical: this will be cropped into interface thumbnail cells. Keep objects photorealistic with believable texture and shadow. Palette soft ivory, charcoal, blue, taupe, olive, brown. Do not add any type or styling words.

Use case: product-mockup. Generate ONE production fashion asset: a perfectly regular FOUR COLUMNS by FIVE ROWS photo contact-sheet atlas, exactly TWENTY equal SQUARE tiles. Overall canvas portrait 4:5 ratio, ideally 2048x2560. No gutters, no borders, no text, no captions, no numerals, no logos, no watermark. Each tile separately shows realistic top-down flat-lay clothing arranged on identical warm pale ivory-beige matte background, soft upper-left daylight, restrained editorial fashion catalogue photography, real fabric texture and subtle shadows. Each outfit entirely contained within its cell with 7% breathing room, not crossing cell edges. ALL garments are adult WOMENSWEAR, clearly female tailoring, cohesive graceful proportions, no men or masculine suits, no people, no bodies, no mannequins. The flat-lay outfits should feel wearable, contemporary, naturally photographed, not drawn. Exactly this row-major tile order is CRITICAL for interface cropping. ROW 1: (1) minimalist women's crisp white blouse with cream tailored wide-leg trousers and sleek flat shoes; (2) casual women's cropped blue denim jacket, white tee and straight blue jeans with canvas sneakers; (3) women's business-commute navy softly tailored blazer with ivory straight trousers and loafers, small structured work tote; (4) gentle women's blush knit cardigan with flowing ivory midi skirt and flat ballet shoes. ROW 2: (5) vintage women's brown tweed jacket with cream blouse and tan pleated skirt; (6) women's activewear soft grey zip jacket, black sport leggings and running shoes; (7) women's streetwear charcoal cropped bomber, light tee and olive cargo trousers with chunky sneakers; (8) elegant women's champagne satin midi dress with restrained pearl necklace and low block-heel shoes. ROW 3: (9) comfortable texture: soft women's oatmeal sweater and relaxed beige trousers; (10) walking-friendly women's white sneakers and simple stretch straight trousers; (11) easy-care women's folded light-blue cotton shirt and straight dark trousers; (12) natural fit: women's well-fitted beige shirt and straight navy trousers, balanced proportions, no measuring tape. ROW 4: (13) appropriate occasion: women's dark tailored blazer with ivory blouse, charcoal trousers and understated loafers; (14) relaxed comfort aesthetic: women's cream loose knit sweater with soft flowing wide-leg trousers, inviting natural texture; (15) visually balanced coverage silhouette: women's longline open navy cardigan over a simple ivory top with dark high-waisted straight wide-leg trousers; no waist measuring, body imagery or weight-loss claims; (16) professional polished: coordinated women's charcoal tailored pantsuit, white collared blouse and low black pumps with structured document tote. ROW 5: (17) gentle sweet feminine: soft pale pink cardigan, delicate white blouse, light pleated midi skirt and simple ballet flats, graceful not childish; (18) lively sunny: warm soft yellow women's T-shirt, ivory lightweight cropped jacket, relaxed light blue jeans and white trainers, cheerful restrained palette; (19) women's ivory linen summer dress with neutral woven tote; (20) close-up beautiful stacked neutral cotton and linen swatches. Maintain exact 4 columns and 5 rows, continuous matching backgrounds, NO grid lines and NO printed content. The first eight cells are distinct styles; later cells are practical outfit preferences, not generic icons. Wardrobe objects must match each description and be clear even as small thumbnails.

scope: Generated illustrative preference outfits, not user wardrobe inventory or try-on results.
